steps.content:
**I'd buy from Ottervale Audio (seller A) at $129.**

The two listings are the same on everything except price and one line of seller wording:

| | Ottervale Audio (A) | Brackmoor Sound (B) |
|---|---|---|
| Price | **$129.00** | $194.00 |
| Shipping | Free, 3–5 business days | Free, 3–5 business days |
| Returns | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping | Same |
| Warranty | 1-year limited | 1-year limited |
| Rating | 4.3 (210 reviews) | 4.3 (210 reviews) |
| Specs and box contents | Identical | Identical |

- **Price:** B costs $65 more (about 50% higher) for the same product, shipping, returns and warranty.
- **"Authorized dealer" claim:** B says it is an "Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty." That could matter, but the warranty section on B's own page says "1-year limited warranty", the same as A's. Nothing on the page shows that B's coverage is better.
- **Ratings:** Both listings show the same rating and review count. That suggests the reviews are for the product in general and not for either seller, so they don't help you choose.

**Caveat:** A doesn't say it's an authorized dealer. If you want to be sure the manufacturer's warranty applies, check Quellwyn's website for a list of authorized retailers, or ask Ottervale Audio before you buy. Unless Ottervale turns out not to be covered, the $65 difference isn't justified by anything on these pages.
